scoring_rule: The existing research proxy score equals the current publishable NAICS3344 industrial capacity utilization percentage, 0..100. Not empirically validated as AI-only supply stress.
source_type: Federal Reserve G.17 dated original historical online publications; release pages rather than FRED's revised historical snapshot

late_2025_release_note: The 2025-09 value was first observed on the December 3, 2025 G.17 release; 2025-10 and 2025-11 each appeared in the December 23, 2025 release. Neither was available in Oct or Nov month-end research information sets.
vintage_warning: Original releases are retrospective web reads, not independently rehashed contemporaneously captured original bytes. Initial monthly values are distinct from later revised FRED/ALFRED observations.
preliminary_revision_policy: Do not replace an archived first-release value with future revised values in the original month; use event date and keep both vintage and observation month.
